title: The Last Terminal Again
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Mirabel Hartwell, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
